newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil panel ok's bill creating power regulator.
newsitem.headline: Brazil panel ok's bill creating power regulator.

text.p: A Brazilian Senate panel approved a bill to create a new power regulator that would oversee the sector which is increasingly moving into private hands, a panel official said.
The Senate Economic Affairs Committee voted in a show of hands in favor of the bill creating the National Electric Energy Agency, the official said.
The bill advances to the full floor of the Senate where it needs to be approved before being signed into law by President Fernando Henrique Cardoso.
